decisions.reason: The new CHGLED connector and R6 changes do not alter the battery connector, its pinout, placement, or unresolved labeling.
Adding J_LED_CHG does not explicitly change the existing board-size, mounting, orientation, clearance, or battery-connector layout constraints.
The charge-status connector and resistor changes do not affect the switched 5V boost supply or its enable behavior.
The source changes the CHGLED output circuitry and R6 but does not modify the resolved VMID-to-VSYS topology or VSYS labeling.
The source does not change the USB-C connector selection, data-line requirement, or sourceability constraints.
The CHGLED circuit changes do not alter battery overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal-protection requirements.
The source does not change the battery NTC sensing method or its connection through J_BAT.
The component and resistor changes do not modify the specified eight-layer PCB stack.
The source does not change the TVS-based ESD protection requirement.
J_LED_CHG is a separate charge-status connector; the source does not change the existing interboard power or signal connector types, pin assignments, or matching-order policy.
The CHGLED and R6 changes do not affect I2C speed, cable length, pull-ups, or series resistors.
The referenced LED is part of the power-board CHGLED circuit and does not change the separate board containing 16 addressable LEDs.
